protocol.population: Fresh-vs-fresh source-confirmed, whole-extent-resolved parents in different selected captions. Old source parents used only for separate retrieval.
protocol.mixture: Half broad random cross-caption pairs, half aspect-matched(abs native log width/height difference<=.35) geometric comparisons. Balance caption dyads by cycling all available combinations, cycle anchor native-envelope-area quartiles for size coverage. Seeded tie/pair choice; no contour or source similarity judgment used.
protocol.extension_rule: Prepare deterministic ordered600-pair pool and hidden-key/source galleries before first rating. Open initial240. Add next120only if binary n<120, same<30,different<30, endpoint-caption coverage<6 or either rating category spans<4 captions. Stop when support achieved or600 exhausted. All opened pairs included; no metric inspected before final ratings seal. If sampling constraints cannot fill600, retain available pool and not-estimable support if minimum unachieved.
protocol.fallbacks: If requested aspect-matched dyad/area stratum has no unused pair, cycle next dyad; if no remaining aspect candidates, leave shortfall explicit, do not replace with nearest-contour pairs. Never change parent eligibility after ratings.
protocol.blind_display: Anonymous sourceRGB crops with source-coordinate bbox as locational aid, equal-size slots, randomized left/right. No caption/parent IDs, selector/aspect values, contour/SDF scores, V3 labels or conventional strings shown.
protocol.ratings: 2 same whole visual organization allowing source-supported ink/size/slant differences;1 partial/related organization;0 different;U unresolved. Preserve1/U, excluded from binary only. Same AI adjudicator, not human inter-rater.
protocol.freeze: Pair pool/protocol sealed before source-similarity rating. All used ratings sealed before predictions. No outcome-informed choosing of metric or normalization.
